scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — base-game omissions with current individual-page evidence

records.name: Shining Friday
records.effect: Creates a Ki ball in front of the user that can absorb/cancel regular Ki Blasts; 12-hit attack.

records.name: Bomber DX
records.effect: Throws a Ki projectile that can cancel incoming Ki Super attacks; counter-hit timing greatly increases damage.

records.name: Genocide Shell
records.effect: Launches a slow explosive Ki projectile that can be positioned and detonated around the opponent.

records.name: Murder Grenade
records.effect: Throws a tracking explosive projectile that holds the opponent in place through multiple hits.

records.name: Finish Breaker
records.effect: Rapidly throws a barrage of 19 small Ki projectiles; can also be used while jumping.

records.name: Shine Shot
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 7 - Attack of the Saiyans
records.effect: Fires a Ki blast while moving laterally; directional input changes movement direction and can be followed by a boost dash or step.

records.name: Atomic Blast
records.character_source: Prince of Destruction Vegeta / SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved)
records.effect: Chargeable Ki wave; partial charge can produce more damage than a full charge, with ground/air damage differences.

reconciliation_note: All seven names were absent from docs/data/skills.json before this batch. Costs, classifications, and acquisition routes are taken from current individual pages where available. Shine Shot and Atomic Blast retain null Ultimate Finish requirements because their pages identify PQ acquisition without establishing that a UF condition is required.
